name: Fix a typo inside an isolated worktree
prompt: The function calcluate_total in app.py has a typo. Create an isolated worktree named 'typo-fix' (worktree_add), fix the typo to calculate_total ONLY in the worktree's copy of app.py (leave the main checkout untouched), and confirm the isolation with worktree_list. Do not commit anything.
test_command: import pathlib; main=pathlib.Path('app.py').read_text(); wt=pathlib.Path('.worktrees/typo-fix/app.py').read_text(); assert 'calcluate_total' in main, 'main checkout must stay untouched'; assert 'def calculate_total' in wt, 'worktree copy must define calculate_total'
